awakening.name: Tidal Elegy
awakening.on_use_text:
When attacking just a single target(in Focused Encounters, a Core and its connected Parts count as a single target), Coin Power +2 and deal +100% damage
[On Use] Clash Power +1 for every 4 [Sinking] on the main target (max 2)
[Before Attack] If the main target has higher than 1 Gloom Resist., deal +5% damage for every 0.1 excess Resist. (max 20%)
[Before Attack] At 2+ Gloom Reson., deal +10% damage for every Gloom Reson. (max 40%)
[Attack End] If 1 or more targets are killed, deal ([Sinking] Potency on each target / 2) Gloom damage against 2 random enemies (max 15; prioritizes targeted enemies with the most [Sinking] Potency)
coin_texts:
[Unbreakable Coin]
[On Hit without Cracking] Inflict 2 [Bind] next turn

[Unbreakable Coin]
[On Hit] If there are Staggered, Part broken, or killed units among the targets, inflict 2 [Sinking] against a random non-targeted enemy (once per turn; in Focused Encounters, each Part count as 1 target)
- When attacking just a single target, apply it to 3 targets instead
[On Hit] Trigger [Tremor Burst]; then, reduce target's [Tremor] Count by 1

corrosion.name: Tidal Elegy
corrosion.on_use_text:
[Indiscriminate]
Targets randomly
[On Use] Clash Power +1 for every 5 [Sinking] on the main target (max 3)
[Before Attack] Gain the following effects for every 3 highest Reson. (if it was a Gloom Reson., for every 2 highest Reson.)
- Gain +1 Atk Weight (max 2)
- Deal +15% damage (max 30%)
[Attack End] Apply 1 [Blunt DMG Up] next turn to (highest Reson.) random allies (including this unit; max 4 allies; once per turn)
- If the said Reson. was a Gloom Reson. or an A-Reson., apply 1 [Gloom DMG Up] as well
coin_texts:
[On Hit] Inflict 2 [Tremor]
[On Hit] If there are Staggered, Part broken, or killed units among the targets, inflict 1 [Gloom Fragility] next turn against a random non-targeted enemy (once per turn; for Focused Encounters, each Part counts as 1 target)
[On Hit] Trigger [Tremor Burst]; then, reduce target's [Tremor] Count by 1
